what: Two US service members reported missing in Morocco, officials say

clean_source_blocks.text: A search and rescue operation is underway for the service members, the US African Command said.
A search and rescue mission involving ground, air, and maritime resources from the US, Morocco and other countries is underway for the service members, officials said.
Two US service members have gone missing during military exercises in Morocco, the US African Command (Africom) said on Sunday.
Two U.S. service members went missing while participating in U.S. Africa Command’s exercise African Lion 2026 in Morocco, the command said.
